result.instructions: Vestige is your long-term memory system. Compose retrievals into recommendations rather than listing their contents when the user is making a decision. On user feedback, call memory(action='promote') for helpful retrievals and memory(action='demote') for wrong ones — do not ask permission, just act.

tools.description: Memory with hindsight. After a failure is recorded, reach backward in time and promote the quiet earlier memory that caused it (same file, env var, or service), which similarity search cannot surface because a root cause rarely resembles the bug. Backward-only by construction (Cai 2024). Pass failure_id (defaults to the latest failure), manual=true to force, promote=false for a dry run.

failure_id.description: ID of the failure/'aversive event' memory to backfill from. If omitted, the most recent memory that looks like a failure is used.

lookback_days.description: How many days back to reach for the cause. Default 30.

manual.description: Force the backfill even if the event isn't auto-detected as salient (manual override). Default false.

promote.description: Whether to actually promote (boost) the surfaced cause(s) in storage. Default true. Set false for a dry-run preview.

scan_limit.description: Max memories to scan as candidate causes. Default 500.

tools.name: backfill
tools.title: Backfill

tools.description: Code memory. Actions: 'remember_pattern', 'remember_decision', 'get_context' (patterns and decisions, each marked current or stale), 'verify' (re-check anchored code memories against the working tree).

action.description: 'remember_pattern' stores a code pattern, 'remember_decision' an architectural decision, 'get_context' returns both with a current-or-stale mark, 'verify' re-checks every anchored code memory against the working tree

alternatives.description: Alternatives that were considered (optional for remember_decision)

anchors.description: Structured form of 'files' for callers that know the symbol. Each anchor is content-hashed at save time so staleness is detectable.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the anchored file

startLine.description: 1-based start line, when the exact span is known

symbol.description: Function/type/class this memory is about. Strongly preferred over a line number: line numbers rot within a week.

decision.description: The architectural or design decision made (required for remember_decision)

description.description: Detailed description of the pattern (required for remember_pattern)

files.description: Files this pattern or decision touches: a path ('src/state.py'), path plus symbol ('src/state.py#load_config'), or path plus lines ('src/state.py:552-580'). Anything beyond a plain path is content-hashed so the memory can report when the code changed.

limit.description: Maximum items per category (default: 10, for get_context)

name.description: Name/title for the pattern (required for remember_pattern)

rationale.description: Why this decision was made (required for remember_decision)

repoPath.description: Repository root used to resolve anchor paths (default: the server's working directory)

verify.description: Check returned code memories against the current source and flag the ones that no longer match (default: true)

tools.name: codebase
tools.title: Codebase

tools.description: Duplicates, merges, supersession, and exact tag maintenance. Actions: 'scan' (default, read-only: duplicate clusters and merge candidates), 'plan_merge' (member_ids to plan_id), 'plan_supersede' (old_id, new_id to plan_id), 'apply' (run a plan_id; weak matches need confirm=true), 'undo' (reverse an operation_id, or omit to list the reflog), 'tag_rename' and 'tag_merge' (preview-token gated), 'protect' (pin against auto-merge), 'policy' (get or set match thresholds). Merged memories are invalidated, never deleted.

action.description: What to do. 'scan' (default): surface duplicate clusters (cosine) AND merge candidates (Fellegi-Sunter), read-only. 'plan_merge'/'plan_supersede': preview a reversible memory plan. 'apply': execute a plan_id. 'undo': reverse a prior memory or tag operation (omit operation_id to list the mixed reflog plus tagOperations). 'tag_rename'/'tag_merge': exact, scoped, preview-token-gated tag maintenance. 'protect': pin a memory. 'policy': get/set Fellegi-Sunter thresholds.

all_scopes.description: [tag_rename/tag_merge] Explicitly operate across every scope. Default false.

auto_apply.description: [policy] Allow 'match' plans to apply without confirm. Default false.

confirm.description: [apply/tag_*] Explicit mutation confirmation. Tag actions always preview when false and require the returned preview_token when true.

exhaustive.description: [scan] Check every valid same-scope pair in both scans; slower, but avoids approximate-filter misses.

member_ids.description: [plan_merge] IDs of memories to merge (>= 2). Survivor kept; rest bitemporally invalidated.

new_id.description: [plan_supersede] Memory that supersedes the old one.

operation_id.description: [undo] Operation to reverse. Omit to list recent merge/supersede operations plus a dedicated tagOperations array that cannot be buried by merge activity.

plan_id.description: [apply] ID of a plan produced by plan_merge/plan_supersede.

preview_token.description: [tag_rename/tag_merge confirm=true] Token returned by the immediately preceding matching preview.

protected.description: [protect] true to pin, false to unpin.

scope.description: [tag_rename/tag_merge] Project scope. Defaults to the isolated 'user' scope.

similarity_threshold.description: [scan] Minimum cosine similarity for duplicate clusters (0.5-1.0, default 0.80).

source_tags.description: [tag_merge] Two or more exact source tags to merge.

survivor_id.description: [plan_merge] Optional: which member to keep (defaults to highest-retention).

tags.description: [scan] Optional: only consider memories with these tags (ANY match).

tools.name: dedup
tools.title: Dedup

tools.description: Memory graph. Actions: 'chain' (path from, to), 'associations' (spreading activation from 'from'), 'bridges' (connectors between from and to), 'predict' (what you will need next, from 'context'), 'memory_graph' (subgraph around center_id or query), 'recent', 'get', 'memory', 'neighbors', 'never_composed', 'bounty_mode' (composition topology), 'label' (record an outcome; the only write).

action.description: Reasoning: 'chain' (from, to), 'associations' (spreading activation from 'from'), 'bridges' (connectors between from and to), 'predict' (next needs, from 'context'), 'memory_graph' (subgraph around 'center_id' or 'query'). Composition topology: 'recent', 'get' (event_id), 'memory' and 'neighbors' (memory_id), 'never_composed', 'bounty_mode', 'label' (record an outcome; the only write).

outcome_type.description: [label] Outcome to record for the composition (the only mutating action).

query.description: [memory_graph] Pick a center node by search query.

tools.name: graph
tools.title: Graph

inputSchema.description: Unified intention management tool. Supports setting, checking, updating (complete/snooze/cancel), and listing intentions.

action.description: 'set' creates, 'check' finds triggered intentions, 'update' changes status (complete, snooze, cancel), 'list' shows them

id.description: [update] ID of the intention to update

snooze_minutes.description: [update] Minutes to snooze for (when status is 'snooze')

status.description: [update] New status: 'complete' marks as fulfilled, 'snooze' delays, 'cancel' cancels

codebase.description: Trigger when working in this codebase

condition.description: Natural language condition for event triggers

file_pattern.description: Trigger when editing files matching this pattern

in_minutes.description: Minutes from now for duration-based triggers

type.description: Trigger type: time-based, context-based, or event-based

tools.description: Lifecycle maintenance. Actions: 'consolidate' (decay and embedding cycle), 'dream' (replay memories into insights and connections), 'gc' (collect stale memories; dry_run=true by default), 'importance_score' (score 'content'), 'backup', 'export' (JSON or JSONL with filters), 'restore' (from 'path').

action.description: 'consolidate' (decay and embedding cycle), 'dream' (replay into insights and connections), 'gc' (stale memories; dry_run=true by default), 'importance_score' (score 'content'), 'backup', 'export' (JSON or JSONL with filters), 'restore' (JSON backup at 'path').

dry_run.description: [gc] Preview only. Defaults to TRUE for safety.

path.description: [restore] Path to a JSON backup file (path-confined).

tools.name: maintain
tools.title: Maintain

tools.description: Manage one memory. Actions: 'get', 'get_batch' (ids), 'state' (accessibility), 'promote' and 'demote' (adjust retrieval strength; demote never deletes), 'edit' (replace content, keep FSRS state), 'purge' (remove content and embeddings for good; confirm=true). 'delete' is an alias for purge.

action.description: 'get' (one node), 'get_batch' (by 'ids'), 'state' (accessibility), 'promote' and 'demote' (adjust retrieval strength; demote never deletes), 'edit' (replace content, keep FSRS state), 'purge' (remove content and embeddings for good; confirm=true). 'delete' is an alias for purge

confirm.description: Required for 'purge' and 'delete'. Purge removes canonical content and embeddings; legacy audit and sync records keep only opaque markers and limited metadata, so this is not verified machine unlearning.

content.description: New content for edit action. Replaces existing content, regenerates embedding, preserves FSRS state.

id.description: The ID of the memory node (for single-memory actions)

ids.description: Array of memory IDs (for get_batch action). Max 20 IDs per call.

reason.description: Why this memory is being promoted/demoted/purged (optional, for logging).

tools.name: memory
tools.title: Memory

tools.description: Store status. view 'health' (default: stats, decay preview, module health, warnings), 'retention' (average, distribution, trend), 'timeline' (memories by day), 'changelog' (state-change audit trail), 'stats' (hygiene counts by type, tag, age, retention, lifecycle).

all_scopes.description: [stats view] Explicitly aggregate every stored scope. Default false preserves project isolation.

end.description: [timeline/changelog view] End of range (ISO 8601 date or datetime).

limit.description: Max results. timeline: default 50, max 200. changelog: default 20, max 100. stats detail lists: default 50, max 200 (aggregate counts always cover the whole store). Ignored by health and retention.

memory_id.description: [changelog view] Per-memory mode: state transitions for this memory id.

schema_introspection.description: [health view] Include the response-schema description in the output.

scope.description: [stats view] Exact normalized memory scope to aggregate (default 'user'). Ignored when all_scopes=true.

start.description: [timeline/changelog view] Start of range (ISO 8601 date or datetime).

view.description: 'health' (default): system health, stats, decay preview, warnings, recommendations. 'retention': average, distribution, trend. 'timeline': memories by date. 'changelog': state-change audit trail. 'stats': hygiene counts by type, tag, age, retention, and lifecycle, with bounded detail lists and recent tag operations.

tools.name: memory_status
tools.title: Memory Status

tools.description: Retrieve from memory. mode 'lookup' (default): fast hybrid keyword and semantic search. 'reason': deep pass with trust scoring, spreading activation, supersession, and contradictions; needs 'query', use when accuracy matters. 'contradictions': disagreement pairs for a 'topic'. Reading never changes strength; promote what helped via memory.

concrete.description: Literal search: no semantic expansion, reweighting, activation, or side effects. Auto-enabled for quoted strings, env vars, UUIDs, paths, and code identifiers.

context_topics.description: Optional topics for context-dependent retrieval boosting

depth.description: [reason mode] How many memories to analyze (default 20, max 50).

detail_level.description: 'brief': id, type, tags, score. 'summary' (default): the 8-field response. 'full': every field, including FSRS state and timestamps.

exclude_types.description: Node types to exclude. Reflections are excluded by default so they do not pollute factual queries.

includeCrossScope.description: Search across all project namespaces. Defaults to false; set only when cross-project retrieval is intentional.

include_types.description: If set, only return nodes of these types. Overrides exclude_types.

min_trust.description: [contradictions mode] Minimum trust for both sides of a contradiction (default 0.3).

mode.description: 'lookup' (default): fast hybrid search. 'reason': deep pass with trust scoring, spreading activation, supersession, and contradiction analysis; needs 'query'. 'contradictions': trust-weighted disagreement pairs for a 'topic', or recent memories.

rank_native_fusion.description: Experimental: fuse the post-retrieval stages as ranked lists (weighted RRF) instead of score multipliers. Default off.

retrieval_mode.description: 'precise': top results only, skips activation and competition. 'balanced' (default): the full cognitive pipeline. 'exhaustive': 5x overfetch, deep graph traversal, no competition.

scope.description: Project namespace. Defaults to 'user', so project memories never bleed into an unscoped recall.

since.description: [contradictions mode] RFC3339 timestamp; only memories updated after this are considered.

source_author.description: Investigation filter: the source author/reporter (not assignee).

source_id.description: Only this source record id (issue number or ticket id). Pair with source_system.

source_project.description: Only memories from this source project or repo, exact match (GitHub 'owner/repo', Redmine project id).

source_status.description: 'any' (default), 'valid' (currently visible upstream), or 'tombstoned' (removed upstream, kept for audit).

source_system.description: Only memories ingested from this external system, e.g. 'github' or 'redmine'. Post-filter; raise 'limit' if it thins results heavily.

source_type.description: Investigation filter: source record type, e.g. 'issue', 'comment'.

source_updated_after.description: Investigation filter: only records whose source was updated at/after this RFC3339 timestamp (inclusive).

source_updated_before.description: Investigation filter: only records whose source was updated at/before this RFC3339 timestamp (inclusive).

tag_prefix.description: Keep only results with a tag starting with this prefix (case-insensitive), e.g. 'meeting:' matches 'meeting:standup'. Post-filter; raise 'limit' if it thins results heavily.

token_budget.description: Max tokens for the response; content is truncated to fit. Fetch full content by id with memory(action='get').

topic.description: [contradictions mode] Topic to scope contradiction detection. If omitted, scans recent memories.

validAt.description: Only facts valid at this time: 'now', RFC3339, or YYYY-MM-DD. When omitted, expired and future facts stay auditable but are downranked.

tools.name: recall
tools.title: Recall

tools.description: Inspect a persisted retrieval receipt ('get') or run a controlled ablation of its frozen evidence pack ('replay', which withholds named slots without rerunning search, calling a model, or claiming causality).

action.description: 'get': one persisted receipt with its safe replay-capsule summary. 'replay': withhold named evidence slots from the frozen final context without rerunning retrieval.

receipt_id.description: Source receipt id. For replay this must be a retrieval receipt that has a frozen replay capsule.

withheld_slots.description: [replay] Receipt-local slots to remove from the frozen final context. Search is never rerun and removed candidates are never backfilled.

tools.name: receipt
tools.title: Receipt

tools.description: Start-of-session context in one call: relevant memories, open intentions, store status, predictions, and codebase context under one token budget. Replaces separate recall, intention, memory_status, and codebase calls.

context.description: Current context for intention matching and predictions

token_budget.description: Max tokens for response (default: 1000). Server truncates content to fit budget. With 1M context models, budgets up to 100K are practical.

tools.name: session_start
tools.title: Session Start

tools.description: Save to memory with Prediction Error Gating: 'content' is created, merged into a similar memory, or supersedes an outdated one. Batch mode: 'items' (max 20) for session-end saves, each through the full pipeline.

acceptedTagSuggestions.description: Accepted input-tag to existing-tag mappings from a preflight response, revalidated against current same-scope suggestions before ingest.

allowSecrets.description: Allow a detected credential to be stored for this single item. Dangerous: normally redact the value or store a secret-manager reference instead.

batchMergePolicy.description: Batch only. 'force_create' (default) keeps caller-separated items separate; 'smart' allows Prediction Error Gating against existing memories.

content.description: The content to remember. Will be compared against existing memories. (Single mode)

forceCreate.description: Force creation of a new memory even if similar content exists

items.description: Batch mode: up to 20 items to save, each force-created unless batchMergePolicy='smart'. Use at session end or before context compaction.

acceptedTagSuggestions.description: Explicitly accepted tag mappings from a prior preflight.

allowSecrets.description: Allow a detected credential for this item only. Defaults to false; do not use for ordinary session summaries.

forceCreate.description: Force creation of this item even if similar content exists

node_type.description: Type: fact, concept, event, person, place, note, pattern, decision

previewTagSuggestions.description: Read-only per-item tag/validity preflight; this item is not stored.

scope.description: Project namespace for this item. Overrides the batch scope when supplied.

tags.description: Tags for categorization. Similar existing same-scope tags are returned as non-mutating suggestions.

validFrom.description: When this item becomes true (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, one unambiguous 'as of YYYY-MM-DD' phrase is inferred.

validUntil.description: When this item stops being true (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD; after validFrom).

node_type.description: fact, concept, event, person, place, note, pattern, decision, or state. 'state' is a snapshot that rots (versions, progress, inventories): without validUntil it expires after VESTIGE_STATE_TTL_DAYS (default 30), then is downranked and marked currentlyValid=false, still auditable via validAt.

previewTagSuggestions.description: Read-only preflight. Returns same-scope similar-tag suggestions and inferred validity without storing anything.

scope.description: Project namespace for this memory. Defaults to 'user' for backward compatibility. Recall searches this namespace unless includeCrossScope=true.

source.description: Source or reference for this knowledge

tags.description: Tags for categorization. The response non-destructively suggests close existing tags in the same scope; suggestions are never auto-applied.

validFrom.description: When the fact becomes true (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, one unambiguous 'as of YYYY-MM-DD' phrase in content is inferred and reported.

validUntil.description: When this fact stops being true. Use RFC3339 or an exact YYYY-MM-DD date; must be after validFrom.

tools.name: smart_ingest
tools.title: Smart Ingest

tools.description: Index an external system into local, searchable memories that cite the canonical record. source='github' (repo='owner/name', GITHUB_TOKEN env) or 'redmine' (project, REDMINE_URL and REDMINE_API_KEY env). Re-runs update changed items; reconcile=true tombstones items removed upstream.

max_pages.description: Max API pages to fetch this run (each page is up to 100 issues). Lets a first sync of a large project be resumed across calls. Default 10.

project.description: Redmine only: project identifier (slug or numeric id) to sync. The Redmine host comes from the REDMINE_URL env var.

reconcile.description: Also tombstone local memories for issues no longer visible upstream (an extra full enumeration pass). Default false on incremental syncs.

source.description: External system to sync: 'github' (GitHub Issues) or 'redmine' (a Redmine project).

tools.name: source_sync
tools.title: Source Sync

tools.description: Inhibit a memory without deleting it (top-down suppression, Anderson 2025 and Davis Rac1): it drops out of retrieval and decays faster, each call compounds, and a background worker spreads accelerated decay to co-activated neighbours. reverse=true undoes it within 24 hours.

inputSchema.description: Top-down suppression (Anderson 2025 SIF, Davis Rac1): the memory persists but is inhibited from retrieval and decays faster. Each call compounds. A background worker spreads accelerated decay to co-activated neighbours over 72 hours. Reversible within 24 hours via reverse=true.

reason.description: Optional free-form note explaining why this memory is being suppressed. Logged for audit.

reverse.description: If true, reverse a previous suppression. Only works within the 24-hour labile window.

tools.title: Suppress
